ciso_ms_capitalist_lending_conditions_effect = {
	scope = state
	is_shown = {
		NOT = {
			is_target_in_variable_list = {
				name = ciso_society_measures
				target = flag:ciso_ms_capitalist_lending
			}
		}
		NOT = {
			has_law = law_type:law_traditionalism
			has_law = law_type:law_cooperative_ownership
			has_law = law_type:law_command_economy
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_variable = ciso_ms_capitalist_lending_investment_var
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = ciso_ms_capitalist_lending_investment_var
				value = 0
			}
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = ciso_ms_capitalist_lending_investment_var
			add = 50
		}
		add_to_variable_list = {
			name = ciso_society_measures
			target = flag:ciso_ms_capitalist_lending
		}
		ciso_update_cost = yes
		ciso_apply_ms_effect = {
			ms = ciso_ms_capitalist_lending
		}
	}
}

		has_variable = ciso_ms_soup_kitchen_is_suppressed
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = ciso_ms_soup_kitchen_is_suppressed
			}
			remove_variable = ciso_ms_soup_kitchen_is_suppressed
			ciso_update_cost = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = ciso_ms_soup_kitchen_is_suppressed
			ciso_update_cost = yes
		}
	}
}
ciso_ms_schooling_conditions_effect = {
	scope = state
	is_shown = {
		NOT = {
			is_target_in_variable_list = {
				name = ciso_society_measures
				target = flag:ciso_ms_schooling
			}
		}
		always = yes
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_variable = ciso_ms_schooling_investment_var
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = ciso_ms_schooling_investment_var
				value = 0
			}
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = ciso_ms_schooling_investment_var
			add = 50
		}
		add_to_variable_list = {
			name = ciso_society_measures
			target = flag:ciso_ms_schooling
		}
		ciso_update_cost = yes
		ciso_apply_ms_effect = {
			ms = ciso_ms_schooling
		}
	}
}
ciso_ms_schooling_increment_effect = {
	scope = state
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_variable = ciso_ms_schooling_investment_var
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = ciso_ms_schooling_investment_var
				value = 0
			}
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = ciso_ms_schooling_investment_var
			add = 25
		}
		clamp_variable = {
			name = ciso_ms_schooling_investment_var
			min = 0
			max = 100000000
		}
		ciso_update_cost = yes
		ciso_apply_ms_effect = {
			ms = ciso_ms_schooling
		}
	}
}

			remove_variable = ciso_ms_street_naming_is_suppressed
			ciso_update_cost = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = ciso_ms_street_naming_is_suppressed
			ciso_update_cost = yes
		}
	}
}
ciso_ms_health_center_conditions_effect = {
	scope = state
	is_shown = {
		NOT = {
			is_target_in_variable_list = {
				name = ciso_society_measures
				target = flag:ciso_ms_health_center
			}
		}
		always = yes
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_variable = ciso_ms_health_center_investment_var
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = ciso_ms_health_center_investment_var
				value = 0
			}
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = ciso_ms_health_center_investment_var
			add = 50
		}
		add_to_variable_list = {
			name = ciso_society_measures
			target = flag:ciso_ms_health_center
		}
		ciso_update_cost = yes
		ciso_apply_ms_effect = {
			ms = ciso_ms_health_center
		}
	}
}
ciso_ms_health_center_increment_effect = {
	scope = state
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_variable = ciso_ms_health_center_investment_var
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = ciso_ms_health_center_investment_var
				value = 0
			}
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = ciso_ms_health_center_investment_var
			add = 25
		}
		clamp_variable = {
			name = ciso_ms_health_center_investment_var
			min = 0
			max = 100000000
		}
		ciso_update_cost = yes
		ciso_apply_ms_effect = {
			ms = ciso_ms_health_center
		}
	}
}
